pr_comments: @ovflowd Since doc rendering might be changed to a different mechanism, is there any chance this might be better implemented elsewhere?

The generation will be done elsewhere in the future, and the tooling will be an NPM package. I believe adding a "Copy code" feature is OK for now. So as you know, this code might be discarded entirely in the future.

Thank you for triaging @debadree25 @tniessen

Hi @ovflowd, I agree that the `nodejs.dev` would be much easier to work with as this one is really adding feature to the legacy code. I am ok with discarding it after we moved to `nodejs.dev`, it is just a good addition for the moment.

Thanks for letting me know earlier, so I would not plan to spend too much time on the legacy code 😄

> Hi @ovflowd, I agree that the nodejs.dev would be much easier to work with as this one is really adding feature to the legacy code. I am ok with discarding it after we moved to nodejs.dev, it is just a good addition for the moment.

I never said anything about nodejs.dev; from where did you assume that? 😅 I have no idea what you mean by this going to nodejs.dev

-- edit

I think I got what you're referring to; maybe you saw the "test/playground" we're doing on https://nodejs.dev/api/; just to let you know, that's not what I meant with the new docs tooling. There's an issue on nodejs/next-10#166 that is what I was referring to.

@ovflowd after reading your previous reply, then on the side bar github _explore/repositories_ suggest it [nodejs/nodejs.dev](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.dev) to me 😅 I had a look and assumed that would be where the future of the nodejs doc would be, apologise that I made a wrong guess ;)

would you guys mind having a look at this PR again? @debadree25 @tniessen 👀

issue_context.title: doc: copy example code to the clipboard
issue_context.body:
### What is the problem this feature will solve?

In documentation, it would be good to have a button next to the code example (snippets) to be able to copy the code to clipboard.

### What is the feature you are proposing to solve the problem?

When reading nodejs doc is inevitable to copy the example code and have a bit of play, usually it is fine as the code examples are not too long, however there are code examples that are page long and makes copy paste not as easy as just a button click.

### What alternatives have you considered?

_No response_

review_comments: The event handler may be able to extract.

Hi @btea thank you for your feedback, I am just not too sure if it is worth the effort of function extraction.
* The code is temp and won't live in the future doc tool
* the function is relatively short and straightforward

Yeah, what you said makes sense.  I made this point because each page of the nodejs official website has a lot of content, and some have many code blocks, so there may be many bindings of the same event, so I think it is worth extracting. 

Anyway, I think this feature looks great 👍
